subject: Corrected Developmental Editing Materials - Establishing Glory: The Library
body:
Good day, Jackie,

Your developmental edit of Establishing Glory: The Library is ready for review.

We found that the manuscript file included with our earlier message was not the correct review copy. We have corrected that, and the complete edited manuscript is attached here along with a short review guide.

Please review the manuscript carefully. If everything looks good, reply with "Approved." If you would like changes, simply tell us what you would like adjusted.

Once we receive your response, we will move the book to the next editing stage.

If you have any questions while reviewing it, just reply to this email.

The Publishing Team
J Merrill Publishing, Inc.
